title: contractDocuments
responsibility: Enumerates nested specification JSON files without following symlink entries and parses one document with readable failure labels.

inputs.name: contractFiles.directory
inputs.description: Absolute specification directory to enumerate recursively. Missing directories return an empty list; nested symbolic links are not followed.

inputs.name: readContractJson.path
inputs.description: Filesystem path of the JSON contract document to read; callers supply a path discovered in a specification directory.

inputs.name: readContractJson.label
inputs.description: Human-readable project-relative contract path included when reading or JSON parsing fails.

outputs.name: contractFiles
outputs.description: Sorted JSON file paths from the requested directory tree. A missing directory yields an empty array and symlink entries are omitted.

outputs.name: readContractJson
outputs.description: The parsed JSON value, including objects, arrays, primitives or null; it is intentionally unvalidated until the caller applies its schema.

errors.name: Filesystem rejection
errors.description: Original Node filesystem error while listing a specification directory, except ENOENT which is treated as empty. The original code and message are preserved.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Reading or parsing the requested JSON document failed; the supplied display label identifies the file.
